stages.title: Play the story
stages.blurb: Five chapters, 60-80 hours. Keep a save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots + 1 autosave). Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before the chapter ends. Scan vehicles and animals as you go - it already counts toward 100%.

stages.title: Strangers & side missions
stages.blurb: Eight stranger strands and the five side-character final missions. Start Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3 - one checklist warns it may expire. Everything else stays open in free-roam after the story.

stages.title: Activities, races & ranges
stages.blurb: 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 14 drone race wins, 20 race wins, fishing, arcade, bowling, robberies and stunts on the road. No gold medals are needed for story missions.

stages.title: Collectibles & counts
stages.blurb: 18 meditation spots (15 needed for 100%), 3 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 250 stunts, 100 vehicles, 50 challenges, and exploring all of Leonida. Nothing here expires.

stages.title: Crime, money & the platinum
stages.blurb: 5 bank vaults (8 for 100%), $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, 8 garages, 10 Scooter Bros registrations, then the last unconfirmed trophies - and A Long Road (100% completion) before the platinum pops.

watch.note: One meditation at Jason's house is only open in Chapter 1. After Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. The balcony meditation raises the counter +1 but is not marked as a spot - whether the trophy needs it is unconfirmed. Do it anyway: two minutes.
Andy's strand. Quest givers return in free-roam after the story, so this is not missable - start it early only so you are not waiting on it at the end.
8 stranger strands. Only some questlines count toward the eight and guides are still confirming which. Start Race Against Yago (Chapter 3) the moment it appears - one checklist warns it may expire.
Tyrone's strand. Timed hourglass missions expire, but no trophy needs them. The strand itself stays open after the story.
Bret's unique animal hunt is a one-off inside his strand, but the strand stays open after the story, so the hunt can be done in free-roam.
Cards are collectibles: nothing expires. Any 3 of the 18 sets count, and they stay collectible in free-roam.
Needs your partner with you to build 4 stars together - easiest during the story when you travel together.
Needs your partner for 3 shops back-to-back. Plan a route with three close shops; if the wanted level drops between robberies the chain resets.
Unlock unconfirmed - the description is cryptic and no guide has confirmed the method yet. Watch the sources for updates.

gates.title: Chapter 1
gates.note: Do the balcony meditation before this chapter ends. Shirley's errands and the house magazines also go away here - they need no trophy.

gates.title: Chapter 2
gates.note: First chapter-break trophy pops here. Nothing trophy-related locks in this chapter.

gates.title: Chapter 3
gates.note: Start Race Against Yago the moment it appears - one checklist warns it may expire.

gates.title: Chapter 4
gates.note: Bank jobs open through an optional mission in this chapter - 8 vaults exist, 100% needs all 8.

gates.title: Chapter 5 - finale
gates.note: Keep a save before the final mission: there is no mission replay. After the credits, free-roam opens and the 100% checklist appears.

disputes.topic: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation required?
disputes.a: Yes - do it: PowerPyx and KeenGamer call Positive Mental Attitude the game's only possibly missable trophy and tell you to meditate on the balcony in Chapter 1.
disputes.b: Maybe not - the balcony meditation raises the counter but is not marked as a spot, and only 15 of 18 meditations are needed for 100%; HappyGamer notes it may not be required.
disputes.call: Do it in Chapter 1. Two minutes removes the risk either way.

disputes.a: 28 hidden - the official list as the kit publishes it, and CryptoGames counts 28.
disputes.b: 26 hidden - The Games Wiki's table marks 26 as hidden.
disputes.call: This guide follows the kit's official list: 28 hidden. The two extra are story trophies the wiki shows as visible.

disputes.a: 4/10 - PowerPyx, KeenGamer and The Games Wiki all rate it 4/10: time, not reflexes.
disputes.b: 7/10 - GTASnaps notes some guides rate it 7/10.
disputes.call: 4/10 on the guides that break the work down: the cost is ~200 hours, almost all of it the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. No online trophies, no DLC trophies and no second playthrough are needed: every trophy is single-player and one playthrough is enough, so the platinum is simply the last trophy you earn. Budget roughly 200 hours for the whole run — the 100% completion trophy is the long pole.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies; this one pops last, on its own.
No online trophies, no DLC and no second playthrough are needed - every trophy is single-player and one playthrough is enough.
Budget about 200 hours; A Long Road (100% completion) is the long pole of the run.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion on the in-game checklist, which opens after the story. This is the hardest trophy and the long pole of the platinum: guides estimate about 200 hours in total. The checklist is lenient but broad — it needs 300 stunts (of 397 in the world), all 8 bank jobs, and the other completion items — so use the in-game list as your tracker and mop it up after the story.

steps.text: Attain 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which opens after the story.
The checklist is lenient - about 60% of what the game holds: 300 of 397 stunts, 8 bank vaults, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans.
Hardest trophy in the game; guides estimate about 200 hours total for the platinum.
Progress made during the story already counts toward it.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts across Leonida, and 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past 250 if you want the platinum. The in-game stunt counter tracks your total.

steps.text: Complete 250 stunts - jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count.

steps.text: Try each of the 9 activity types once - any single try counts, no win needed.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: one spot is at Jason's house and is only open in Chapter 1 — meditate there before Chapter 1 ends, or the trophy may be locked for the playthrough. The other 17 spots stay available, and the in-game map marks spots you have used.

steps.text: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida (10 locations; meditating with both characters at one spot counts +2).
POSSIBLY MISSABLE: after Down to Earth (Chapter 1), talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept.
The balcony meditation raises the counter +1 but is not marked as a spot - whether the trophy needs it is unconfirmed. Do it anyway: two minutes.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

dispute.a: Yes - the game's only missable: PowerPyx and KeenGamer tell you to do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1.
dispute.b: Maybe not - the balcony spot is not marked like the others and only 15 of 18 are needed for 100%; HappyGamer notes it may not be required.
dispute.call: Do it in Chapter 1. Two minutes removes the risk either way.
